fields.title: 1. Statements and Sources
fields.md:
### 1-1. Amodei Statement (reported 2026-11-20)

| Item | Content | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Published | wccftech 2026-11-20 08:21 EST (Ramish Zafar) | [wccftech](https://wccftech.com/anthropic-ceo-dario-amodei-says-spacex-compute-is-high-quality-and-anthropic-is-enjoying-working-with-spacex-casting-doubt-on-shock-q2-2027-exit-reports/) |
| Venue | CNBC, interview with Andrew Ross Sorkin — the article does not give the interview date | Same |
| Quotes | "you can't be sure what you're going to do in the future" · "we're finding that compute to be, you know, high quality." · "We're enjoying working with SpaceX." | Same |
| Source chain | The only link in the article is an X post (@firesidealpha). The CNBC video and transcript could not be verified | Same · search 2026-11-22 KST |
| Numbers in the same article | Per Anthropic filings, about $3.1 billion per month from December — a figure already recorded from Bloomberg on 10/29, not a new number | Same · `state.triggers_next_12m[T14]` |
| Cross-check | kantan.news 11/20 — paraphrases the same content; no quotes | [kantan.news](https://kantan.news/news/anthropic-and-spacex-partnership-continues-dario-amodei-responds-to-departure-rumors) |

- **Reading**: The CEO of the counterparty company expressed satisfaction. In the same sentence he said the future cannot be guaranteed, so this is not a commitment to extend. Nor is there any sentence denying the 11/11 account (a sell-side meeting memo relayed on X by Jukan of Citrini Research). The headline's "casting doubt" is the report's interpretation (Source: wccftech 11/20 · `state.triggers_next_12m[T14].log_status`).

### 1-2. Primary Sources — Anthropic Listing Filings (EDGAR, CIK 2130357)

| Filing | Filed | Content | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| FWP pricing | 11/18 | Offering price $83 · base 980 million shares (company 956,351,354 · selling shareholders 23,648,646) · size $81.34 billion (excluding the option to purchase an additional 147 million shares) · concurrent private placement Class N $26 billion · trading 11/19 · settlement 11/20 · no mention of SpaceX | [FWP](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026074937/anthropicpbc-fwppricing.htm) |
| 424B4 final prospectus | 11/19 | accn 0001628280-26-074944 — **could not be opened** because it exceeds the tool's capacity (10MB) | [EDGAR submissions](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0002130357.json) |
| S-1/A | 11/02 · 11/10 · 11/17 | Full-text search for 'SpaceXAI' returned hits (only confirmed that the clause exists; context not read) | [EDGAR full-text search](https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22SpaceXAI%22&ciks=0002130357) |

- The full-text search for 'SpaceXAI' returned hits in the S-1 (10/26), 3 S-1/A filings, the 424B4, and 3 FWP filings (Source: [EDGAR full-text search](https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22SpaceXAI%22&ciks=0002130357), 2026-11-22 KST).

### 1-3. Clauses — Confirmed Only Through Reports (Original Text Not Read)

| Item | Reported content | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Cap | Up to $120.5 billion of SpaceXAI GPU capacity (through 2029) — a cap, not a confirmed amount | [TechTimes 11/16](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/330782/20261116/anthropic-compute-commitments-hit-9009-billion-spacex-can-cancel-deal-worth-1205-billion.htm) (citing S-1/A 11/10) |
| Initial non-cancellable period | Ends 2027-01 · 2027-03 (varies by contract) | Same |
| Termination | Thereafter, **either party** may terminate with 90 days' written notice | Same |

- **Newly recorded**: the statement that the notifying party is "either party." Until now, the state's T14 had left the notifying party blank as an item to verify. Since this is not a fact confirmed from the original text, the T14 check records it only as "either party, per reports" (Source: TechTimes 11/16 · `state.triggers_next_12m[T14].check`).

### 1-4. CEO Remarks in the Same Week (Candidate Table)

| Date | Statement | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 11/18 | NYT DealBook — Anthropic's 'most likely outcome' is an additional 10GW from SpaceX ('would like an incremental 10 gigawatts of compute from SpaceX') | [wccftech 11/19](https://wccftech.com/elon-musk-says-anthropic-wants-to-rent-an-additional-10-gw-of-compute-from-spacex-warning-power-is-the-real-limiting-factor-as-his-starbase-clears-1456-mws-of-gas-turbines/) |

- This is the CEO relaying the counterparty's words. There is no confirmation from Anthropic. The 10GW is merely a statement about compute demand and is not progress on C-2027-1 (nameplate GW). The same article's "Starbase gas turbines 1,456MW permit" cites an X post, so it was not used for T12 either (Source: wccftech 11/19 · `state.musk_statements_as_milestone_candidates_only`).
